Video Maker HD 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Create polished HD videos by combining, editing, and exporting clips in 1080p MP4.
- Supports uploads of MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM (max 500MB); seamless cloud-based processing.
- Simple chat-driven workflow: combine clips, add background music, add text, and export.
- No editing software required — just upload, describe your needs, and download the result.
- Automatic setup and connection to cloud backend with instant anonymous use (free credits included).
- Fast processing (usually under 2 minutes for short videos); ideal for rapid content creation.
